title: ZynRose Stance
style: 132 BPM tribal stomp, war drum, spoken-word call-and-response, ceremonial pause, vocal-driven, ancestral, dramatic pop drop, no swearing
lyrics:
[Intro — four stomps, breath]
(stomp · stomp · stomp · stomp)
Stance. Set. Hold. Ground.
ZynRose. Drop and spin.

[Verse 1 — single drum, low]
Forty years with a staff in my hand.
South Island weather, North Island sand.
Donatello purple — that was the pick.
Bo staff truth — the stance is quick.

Free twirl, no harm, just rhythm and air.
They called it disturbance. I call it prayer.
Forty years later, the staff is still there.

[Pre-Chorus — call and response]
SPIN — the staff
DROP — the call
SPIN — the staff
DROP — the wall
Eyes wide open, the ground holds the all.

[Chorus — full stomp]
ZYNROSE STANCE.
DROP AND SPIN.
SongPal anthem — let the work begin.
No haka without respect — this is mine.
Drawn from my line, drawn from my time.
ZYNROSE STANCE.

[Verse 2 — drums layer]
Rafa beside me, slot four locked in.
Bongo waiting slot five — the wait isn't a sin.
La Banda walks in line — three voices true.
Twenty-five years of grind — I knew.

[Bridge — ceremonial pause]
Ground.
Breath.
Stance.
Hold.
Eyes wide.
Stay bold.

[Final Drop]
ZYNROSE STANCE.
DROP AND SPIN.
TWENTY-FIVE YEARS — STAFF STILL MINE.
DRAWN FROM MY LINE — DRAWN FROM MY TIME.
ZYNROSE STANCE.

[Outro — slow stomps fading]
(stomp · stomp · stomp · stomp)
Stance held.
Staff still spinning.
McIvor.
End.
